en.headline: Ciao Gelato Fest continues at PMQ through Sunday
en.dek: PMQ lists the Italian-style gelato market running from noon to 10pm on Saturday and Sunday at the ground-floor courtyard, with free entry.
body: The Ciao! Gelato Fest 2026 is running its second weekend at PMQ in Sheung Wan, according to the venue’s event page.

Organisers Circus Media (H.K.) Limited said the market brings 20 gelato brands from Hong Kong, Macau, Portugal and Italy to the ground-floor courtyard and marketplace from 9 to 11 October, daily from noon to 10pm. Entry is free.
A gelato tasting pass for six mini cups is available on site for 188 dollars, the organisers said. The first weekend of the event took place from 1 to 4 October.
The venue is at 35 Aberdeen Street. The organisers listed Instagram accounts for further brand and flavour details.

zh.headline: 元創方Ciao意式雪糕市集展至周日
zh.dek: 元創方活動頁列出，意式雪糕市集周六及周日中午12時至晚上10時於地面廣場舉行，入場免費。
body: 元創方活動頁顯示，「Ciao! Gelato Fest 2026」意式雪糕市集正進行第二個周末。
主辦單位盛薏香港有限公司表示，市集匯聚來自香港、澳門、葡萄牙及意大利的20個雪糕品牌，於10月9日至11日每日中午12時至晚上10時在地面廣場及市集舉行，入場免費。
主辦單位指，現場可購買188元嚐味通行證，換取六杯迷你雪糕。活動首個周末為10月1日至4日。
場地位於鴨巴甸街35號元創方。主辦單位列出Instagram帳戶供查閱品牌及口味詳情。
